ابتكرا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَكَرَا (ibtakarā) /ib.ta.ka.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اُبْتُكِرَا (ubtukirā) /ub.tu.ki.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اِبْتَكِرَا (ibtakirā) /ib.ta.ki.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
